theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_dtfr_current_calculus
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (A B : GeometricCurrentOn U n), (A - B).support ⊆ A.support ∪ B.support ∧ (A - B).massOn W ≤ A.massOn W + B.massOn W) ∧ ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (A B : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), A.boundary.support ⊆ A.support ∧ (A - B).boundary = A.boundary - B.boundary
